Paragraph.Text: PASSPORTS AND OTHER DOCUMENTS ACCEPTED FOR ENTRY MUST BE VALID FOR A MINIMUM OF 3 MONTHS BEYOND THE PERIOD OF INTENDED STAY.
NATIONALS OF FRANCE ARE ALLOWED TO ENTER WITH AN EXPIRED NATIONAL ID CARD WHEN: T*DFT/BA/PA/VA/ID55845
NATIONALS OF FRANCE WITH A NATIONAL ID CARD.
NATIONALS OF FRANCE WITH AN EMERGENCY PASSPORT.
VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR NATIONALS OF FRANCE FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 90 DAYS.
MINORS UNDER 14 YEARS OF AGE T*DFT/BA/PA/MI/ID32963
THE MAXIMUM STAY IS GRANTED WITHIN 6 MONTHS.
DATE OF EXPIRATION ON VISAS MUST BE AT LEAST ONE DAY AFTER ARRIVAL DATE.
VISITORS NOT HOLDING RETURN/ONWARD TICKETS COULD BE REFUSED ENTRY.
PASSPORTS AND OTHER DOCUMENTS ACCEPTED FOR ENTRY MUST BE VALID FOR A MINIMUM OF 6 MONTHS FROM THE ARRIVAL DATE.
PASSPORTS ISSUED TO NATIONALS OF FRANCE TRAVELING AS TOURISTS MUST BE VALID ON ARRIVAL.
WARNING: IF DEPARTING FROM THE USA (REGARDLESS OF ANY DESTINATION PASSPORT EXEMPTIONS), A VALID PASSPORT AND/OR ACCEPTED DEPARTURE DOCUMENT T*RULES/R9 IS REQUIRED BY THE US IMMIGRATION AUTHORITIES.
NATIONALS OF FRANCE WITH AN EMERGENCY PASSPORT.

VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR PASSENGERS WITH A RESIDENCE OR A RE-ENTRY PERMIT ISSUED BY USA TRAVELING AS TOURISTS FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 90 DAYS. VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR PASSENGERS WITH A TRAVEL DOCUMENT ISSUED TO REFUGEES OR STATELESS PERSONS BY USA TRAVELING AS TOURISTS FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 90 DAYS. VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR PASSENGERS WITH AN EMPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION CARD (FORM I-766) IF ENDORSED "SERVES AS I-512 ADVANCE PAROLE" OR "VALID FOR REENTRY TO US" TRAVELING AS TOURISTS FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 90 DAYS.
PASSENGERS MUST COMPLETE AN "ELECTRONIC TICKET" AT HTTPS://ETICKET.MIGRACION.GOB.DO/ BEFORE BOARDING. THIS WILL GENERATE A QR CODE WHICH MUST BE PRESENTED UPON ARRIVAL.
VISITORS MUST HOLD RETURN/ONWARD TICKETS T*RULES/R38.
THIS DOES NOT APPLY TO PASSENGERS WITH A PASSPORT STATING DOMINICAN REP. AS PLACE OF BIRTH.

MALARIA PROPHYLAXIS. MALARIA RISK, EXCLUSIVELY DUE TO P. FALCIPARUM, EXISTS THROUGHOUT THE YEAR, ESPECIALLY IN THE WESTERN PROVINCES OF DAJABON, ELIAS PINA AND SAN JUAN. IN 2015, TRANSMISSION INCREASED IN THE NATIONAL DISTRICT AND THE PROVINCES OF SANTO DOMINGO AND LA ALTAGRACIA, SPECIFICALLY IN BAVARO DISTRICT. RISK IN OTHER AREAS IS LOW TO NEGLIGIBLE. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF P. FALCIPARUM RESISTANCE TO ANY ANTIMALARIAL DRUG. RECOMMENDED PREVENTION IN RISK AREAS: C.
PASSPORTS AND OTHER DOCUMENTS ACCEPTED FOR ENTRY MUST BE VALID FOR THE PERIOD OF INTENDED STAY.
WARNING: IF DEPARTING FROM THE USA (REGARDLESS OF ANY DESTINATION PASSPORT EXEMPTIONS), A VALID PASSPORT AND/OR ACCEPTED DEPARTURE DOCUMENT T*RULES/R9 IS REQUIRED BY THE US IMMIGRATION AUTHORITIES.
NATIONALS OF FRANCE WITH A MACHINE-READABLE EMERGENCY PASSPORT.
VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR NATIONALS OF FRANCE FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 90 DAYS. (SEE NOTE 52667) NOTE 52667: THE MAXIMUM STAY IS GRANTED WITHIN 180 DAYS. EXTENSION OF STAY IS POSSIBLE.
PASSENGERS YOUNGER THAN 18 YEARS TRAVELING TO BARBADOS: T*DFT/BB/PA/MI/ID82456
PASSENGERS MUST PRESENT AN "IMMIGRATION/CUSTOMS FORM" UPON ARRIVAL. THE FORM CAN BE FOUND AT HTTPS://TRAVELFORM.GOV.BB/ OR COMPLETED UPON ARRIVAL AT THE AVAILABLE KIOSKS.

VISITORS MUST HOLD RETURN/ONWARD TICKETS. THEY MUST HAVE A TICKET PROVING THAT THEIR FINAL DESTINATION IS THEIR COUNTRY OF ORIGIN OR RESIDENCE T*RULES/R38. (SEE NOTE 44529) NOTE 44529: THIS DOES NOT APPLY TO PASSENGERS WITH A PASSPORT STATING BARBADOS AS PLACE OF BIRTH.
CHILDREN YOUNGER THAN 1 YEAR AND ADULTS OLDER THAN 60 YEARS.
PASSPORTS AND OTHER DOCUMENTS ACCEPTED FOR ENTRY MUST BE VALID FOR A MINIMUM OF 6 MONTHS FROM THE ARRIVAL DATE.
PASSENGERS WITH A HANDWRITTEN PASSPORT ARE NOT ALLOWED TO ENTER.
VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR NATIONALS OF FRANCE TRAVELING AS TOURISTS WITH A RETURN/ONWARD TICKET CAN OBTAIN A VISA ON ARRIVAL FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 30 DAYS. THEY CAN APPLY TO EXTEND THEIR STAY.
VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR PASSENGERS TRAVELING ON BUSINESS WITH A RETURN/ONWARD TICKET CAN OBTAIN A VISA ON ARRIVAL. THEY MUST HAVE AN INVITATION LETTER ISSUED BY:
THE INVITING ORGANIZATION; OR
THE BANGLADESH INVESTMENT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (BIDA); OR

A BEPZA CERTIFICATE. THE ACCREDITED INVITING ORGANIZATION MUST NOTIFY THE IMMIGRATION AUTHORITIES PRIOR TO ARRIVAL. VISA REQUIRED, EXCEPT FOR PASSENGERS WITH AN ONWARD TICKET CAN OBTAIN A TRANSIT VISA ON ARRIVAL FOR A MAXIMUM STAY OF 72 HOURS.
PASSENGERS WITH A HANDWRITTEN EXTENSION ON A MACHINE READABLE PASSPORT ARE NOT ALLOWED TO ENTER BANGLADESH.
VISITORS NOT HOLDING RETURN/ONWARD TICKETS COULD BE REFUSED ENTRY.
VALID VISAS IN EXPIRED PASSPORTS ARE STILL ACCEPTABLE, PROVIDED ACCOMPANIED BY A VALID PASSPORT OF THE SAME NATIONALITY OF THE EXPIRED PASSPORT.
NO VISA REQUIRED (NVR) RUBBER STAMP SEAL AND PRINTED DIGITAL STICKER ARE ACCEPTED TO ENTER BANGLADESH.

MALARIA RISK EXISTS THROUGHOUT THE YEAR WITH A PEAK FROM MAY THROUGH OCTOBER, BUT TRANSMISSION OCCURS ONLY IN 13 OF 64 DISTRICTS IN BOTH RURAL AND URBAN AREAS. RISK IS HIGH IN CHITTAGONG HILL TRACT DISTRICTS (BANDARBAN, RANGAMATI AND KHAGRACHARI), CHATTOGRAM DISTRICT, AND COX'S BAZAAR DISTRICT. LOW RISK EXISTS IN THE DISTRICTS OF HOBIGONJ, KURIGRAM, MOULVIBAZAR, MYMENSINGH, NETRAKONA, SHERPUR, SUNAMGONJ AND SYLHET. MOST PARTS OF THE COUNTRY, INCLUDING DHAKA CITY, HAVE NO RISK OF MALARIA. RECOMMENDED PREVENTION IN RISK AREAS: C.
IT IS ESSENTIAL THAT ALL VISITORS OBTAIN GOOD MEDICAL INSURANCE WHICH ALSO PROVIDES FOR AEROMEDICAL EVACUATION.
PASSENGERS WHO DO NOT HOLD A YELLOW FEVER CERTIFICATE, IF REQUIRED, WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO DISEMBARK.
PASSENGERS TRANSITING THROUGH TWO AIRPORTS IN THE SCHENGEN AREA MUST COMPLY WITH ENTRY REGULATIONS OF THE FIRST SCHENGEN MEMBER STATE.
